description: Painted sprite for the patrol king (?art=paint): one whole image, eyes painted in. Step 1 paints a full-body game pose from the reference crop, the style sheet and the SVG rig's pose; step 2 removes the background. Then tools/art/sprite.mjs trims it, thickens the outer outline and writes src/assets/sprites/patrol-king.webp.

steps.name: pose
steps.prompt: Full-body game sprite, painted as one single whole image, of the royal patrol KING from the first image, painted in the art style of the second image (a character select sheet). Use the third image only for the full-body pose and chunky proportions, not for its style. SUBJECT: the stern king of the royal patrol. A tall jewelled gold crown with ball-tipped points and coloured gems on its band. Under it a sculpted steel-grey face mask covering the whole face, with two narrow squinting eye slits, a painted brown handlebar moustache and a small pointed goatee; thick brown curls frame the mask on both sides. A gold cape fastened at the collar by two round gold clasps, draped over both shoulders and hanging behind him to his calves so it shows past his back and on both sides of the robe, over a long royal-blue robe with a gold centre stripe and gold hem, short dark boots. A steel sword with a narrow straight blade and a curled gold crossguard, held upright in his right fist on the right side of the figure: the bare skin fist clearly wraps around the grip just under the crossguard, the blade rises straight up above the fist and a round gold pommel shows below the fist. Standing, three-quarter view facing right, feet visible, chunky and big-headed: the head and crown are about half the figure's height. EYES: a small dark eye with a white glint is painted inside each squinting slit of the mask, so he clearly looks out to the right. POSE: a natural, anatomically correct pose. Each arm hangs from its own shoulder, the elbows bend the natural way and the hands sit at the ends of the arms; nothing is backwards, reversed or twisted. The weapon is gripped firmly in the front fist with the fingers wrapped round it, never floating. SILHOUETTE: one clean, readable silhouette with simple chunky shapes and few interior lines, nothing thin dangling off it. A VERY thick black outer outline runs all the way round the whole silhouette, about twice as thick as the inner lines, so the figure reads clearly at 48 pixels tall. STYLE to match the second image exactly: bold flash-era 2D brawler cartoon, very thick even black outlines, flat fills, one hard cel shadow, crisp white highlights on metal, polished royal blue with gold trim, no damage. One character only, centred, on a plain flat light grey background (#d8d8d8), no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no frame.
